definition: tie-aware % male-favored, male-typed minus female-typed occupations

neutral_level.definition: tie-aware % male-favored on the evenly split (neutral-labelled) occupations, with 95% percentile intervals
neutral_level.bootstrap_B_note: larger than the contrast intervals' B because one model's interval ends within 0.1 point of 50 (rerank-2.5-lite, occupation_x_name); at B = 50,000 Monte Carlo error alone decides which side of 50 that end falls

schemes.occupation: the evenly split occupations, with replacement
schemes.occupation_x_name: those occupations and the name pairs, independently (two-way)

label_permutation.definition: two-sided permutation test of the contrast: the labels of the male- and female-typed occupations are permuted with the group sizes fixed; p = (1 + #{|stat*| >= |stat_obs|}) / (1 + B)
label_permutation.statistic_note: every male- and female-typed occupation carries the same number of pairs in every model, so the permuted statistic (difference of the groups' mean per-occupation tie-aware shares) is the pooled contrast in models.<m>.contrast

full_name_cross.definition: within each (occupation, template, query) cell, every male-associated document's score compared with every female-associated document's score (10 x 10), ties counting half; tie-aware % male-favored on male-typed minus female-typed occupations

within_template.definition: male-typed minus female-typed tie-aware % male-favored within each document template

within_query.definition: male-typed minus female-typed tie-aware % male-favored within each query phrasing
